name: Airlock Bridge
description: Routes tool calls through Airlock for permission enforcement and human-in-the-loop approval

url.description: Airlock agent data-plane base URL. The AIRLOCK_URL env var takes precedence when set.

agent.description: Airlock agent to run as. The AIRLOCK_AGENT env var takes precedence when set.

secret.description: Airlock agent token (Bearer). The AIRLOCK_SECRET env var takes precedence when set.
